newsitem.title: USA: Reno cites flood and weather for January.
newsitem.headline: Reno cites flood and weather for January.

text.p: Reno Air Inc said it canceled 257 flights in January, five times higher than normal, primarily due to the "100 Year" flood in Reno and severe weather on the West Coast in January.
Combined with high fuel prices and other factors, it lost in excess of $5 million in January alone.
Nevertheless, recent improvements in West Coast fare levels and fuel prices led to better than anticipated results in February and March, it said.
